profile.name: 通用串口/网络实验仪器
profile.description: 这类设备是带有串口或网络 Socket 命令接口的实验室仪器，可通过文本命令进行控制与状态查询。常见于电源、测量仪表、温控器等设备，用于实验自动化、参数设置和数据读取。
profile.description_en: This refers to a laboratory instrument with a serial or network socket command interface that can be controlled and queried using text commands. Such interfaces are commonly found on power supplies, measurement instruments, temperature controllers, and similar devices for lab automation, parameter setting, and data readout.
